tools.name: search_surnames
tools.description: Filter 3,000 imported 2010 U.S. Census surname records or the website's curated collections. Returns rank-ordered, paginated records and sources. No meanings or availability checks.

tools.name: get_surname_record
tools.description: Look up a stable surname ID returned by search_surnames, with Census rank, count, source and actual collection pages. not_found applies only to this 3,000-record subset.
